<a id="music_freq_lo"></a>
### [`music_freq_lo`](../../../../src/music/music_workspace.asm#L6) `$0C8C-$0C8E`

*variable*

Arrays of 3 bytes are indexed by the voice X (0-2 = SID voice 1-3). The file holds $00/$ff runs and stray values here, not a driver state.
Note frequency low byte, voice x (target of the slide)

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame), [`music_cmd_pattern`](music_driver.md#music_cmd_pattern), [`music_slide_freq`](music_effects.md#music_slide_freq)
- **Written by:** [`music_cmd_pattern`](music_driver.md#music_cmd_pattern)
